header.title: Empty State
header.description: Fallback shown when a list, table or search has nothing to show. It has an icon or illustration, a title, a description and up to two actions. Pass design system buttons to `action` and `secondaryAction`.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to preview the empty state and its code.
playground.sampleDescription: When a customer places an order, it will show up here.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: `title` and `description` are enough. Without `icon` or `image`, it shows the `kind` icon (a folder by default).

texts.title: No orders yet
texts.description: When a customer places an order, it will show up here.

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: `kind` picks the icon and its color: `empty` (folder, neutral), `search` (magnifier, `secondary`) and `filter` (funnel, `tertiary`).

empty.title: No files
empty.description: Upload a file to get started.

search.title: No matches
search.description: Nothing matched “gem-system”. Try a different keyword.

filter.title: No rows match these filters
filter.description: Clear status or date range to see the full table again.

actions.title: With actions
actions.description: `action` is the main action and `secondaryAction` sits next to it. Use `size="sm"` buttons so they don't compete with the title.

texts.title: Create your first project
texts.description: Projects group boards, members and billing in one place.

filter.title: Filters with no results
filter.description: With `kind="filter"`, offer an action to clear the filters. Try the button: it brings the list back.

texts.title: No rows match these filters
texts.description: Clear status or date range to see the full table again.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. It changes padding, gap, icon, title (`h6`, `h5`, `h4`) and the max width of the copy.

texts.title: Size
texts.description: Icon and type scale follow the size.

start.title: Start aligned
start.description: `align="start"` aligns everything to the start. Useful in side panels or forms. `bordered` adds a border and background, and `radius` rounds the corners.

texts.title: Inbox is empty
texts.description: Notifications from billing and comments will land here.

icon.title: Custom icon
icon.description: `icon` replaces the `kind` icon, but the well still follows the `kind` color. `hideIcon` hides it.

image.title: With illustration
image.description: `image` shows an illustration instead of the icon. `children` render below the actions: use them for hints or links. If the illustration is decorative, give it `aria-hidden` or `alt=""`.

texts.title: Nothing in this workspace
texts.description: Drop files here or start from a template.

card.title: In a card
card.description: `minHeight` sets a minimum height to fill a table or panel. A number is taken as pixels.

texts.title: No invoices found
texts.description: Adjust the query or create an invoice to get started.

search.title: With search
search.description: Show the empty state when the search returns nothing. Clear or change the text to see the list.

header.title: EmptyState API
header.description: API reference for the React EmptyState component: props, helper, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `hasEmptyStateNode` is the function that decides whether a prop has content.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: EmptyState accepts <section> attributes except title, which is replaced by the heading. They go to the root along with ref. style is merged with --gem-empty-state-min-h when you pass minHeight.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.status: The root is a <section> with role="status". Pass another role if you don't want that behavior.
a11y.live: status is a live region: if the empty state appears after a search or filter, screen readers announce it.
a11y.labelledby: When there is a title, the root uses aria-labelledby with the title id. Pass aria-label or aria-labelledby to change it.
a11y.heading: A text title renders as <h3>. If you pass a node, it is wrapped in a <div> and is not a heading.
a11y.image: The image wrapper is not hidden. If the illustration is decorative, give it aria-hidden or alt="".
a11y.actions: Use Button or Link for actions so they are focusable and keyboard operable.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.size: Size: `--sm`, `--md` or `--lg`. Sets padding, gap, icon and copy width.
rules.kind: Kind: `--kind-empty`, `--kind-search` or `--kind-filter`. Sets the icon colors.
rules.bordered: Applied with `bordered`. Adds border and background.
rules.title: Title. Receives `classNames.title`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: EmptyState's own variables. The size and kind classes set them, so use `.gem-empty-state.your-class` to override them.

items.--gem-empty-state-gap: Gap between icon, copy and actions.
items.--gem-empty-state-copy: Max width of the copy and `children`.
items.--gem-empty-state-min-h: Minimum height. Set by `minHeight`; defaults to `16rem` when the class is present.

items.--gem-color-secondary-{100|700}: `search` icon well background and icon color.
items.--gem-color-tertiary-{100|700}: `filter` icon well background and icon color.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.title: Heading. Text renders as `<h3>`.
items.kind: Default icon and its color when there is no `icon` or `image`.
items.image: Illustration above the copy. When set, the icon is not shown.
items.children: Extra content below the actions, like hints or links.
items.size: Density: padding, icon and type scale.
items.minHeight: Minimum height. A number is taken as pixels.
items.aria-labelledby: Defaults to the title id when there is a `title`.

items.hasNode: `false` for `null`, `undefined`, booleans and empty strings. It's the rule EmptyState uses to decide which parts to render.
